**TX-0401 amount: verified at EUR 240.00**

- Date: 2026-07-20
- Merchant: TechMart Online
- Type: outgoing card payment, settled
- Account: ACC-1005 (EUR)

For context, TX-0402 is also EUR 240.00 to TechMart Online, dated 2026-07-14 and settled.

**Reason codes that could apply**

I haven't reviewed your case yet, so these are only the codes that match common situations. Each has a filing window counted from the transaction date.

| Reason code | Use when | Window |
|---|---|---|
| duplicate_charge | You were charged more than once for the same purchase | 60 days |
| unauthorized_debit | You did not authorize the payment | 56 days |
| fraud_card_not_present | Your card details were used without your permission for an online or phone payment | 120 days |
| goods_not_received | You paid but did not receive the items | 90 days |
| service_not_rendered | You paid but the service was not provided | 90 days |

Because TX-0401 and TX-0402 share the same merchant and amount, duplicate_charge may be relevant, but only if the two payments were for the same purchase.

Payment dispute rules
## Reason codes and chargeback windows
Each reason code has a window in days from the transaction date. A dispute opened after the window closes is not eligible.

| Reason code | Window (days) |
|---|---|
| fraud_card_not_present | 120 |
| goods_not_received | 90 |
| duplicate_charge | 60 |
| service_not_rendered | 90 |
| unauthorized_debit | 56 |

Dispute handling process
## Review timelines
The review target is 10 business days for card reason codes and 20 business
days for transfer reason codes. Complex cases involving a foreign acquirer may
run to 45 calendar days; the customer is notified when that happens.

Dispute handling process
## Withdrawing a dispute
A customer may withdraw a dispute at any time before resolution. Withdrawal is
final; the same transaction cannot be disputed again under the same reason code.

Notifications
## Dispute updates
A dispute generates a notification on every state change. The notification
names the state, never the internal reason for a decision.
